# kavynUI

> kavynUI is an open-source (MIT) library of 94 animated React components and page sections, monochrome (iOS system grays) with dark and light themes, copy-paste owned. Every component ships with a live animation, a real use case and graceful fallbacks (WebGL degrades to CSS gradients, reduced-motion variants). No dependencies beyond React, Tailwind CSS and Motion.

## Pages

- [Components](https://kavynui.com/components): full searchable catalog of every component and block
- [Sections](https://kavynui.com/blocks): whole page sections (hero, features, pricing, FAQ, CTA, footer)
- [Backgrounds](https://kavynui.com/backgrounds): gradient and shader backgrounds
- [Templates](https://kavynui.com/templates): complete end-to-end product designs by Enzo, sold as source-you-own templates; the component library stays free (MIT)
- [Docs](https://kavynui.com/docs): installation, theming, usage, motion, accessibility
- [Blog](https://kavynui.com/blog): design and engineering notes

## Component families

- Sections: Whole page sections, in the order a page reads
- Buttons: Calls to action that answer the cursor
- Forms & inputs: Capture emails, photos and files
- Navigation: Headers, menus, tabs and steps
- Text: Headlines with timing and texture
- Cards & layout: Feature grids, bento tiles and surfaces
- Social proof: Reviews, logos and community
- Interactive: Things people tap, drag and open
- Maps & data: Dashboards, maps and live metrics
- Loaders: Waiting that feels designed
- Scroll & cursor: Stories that move as people read
- Backgrounds: Shaders and canvases behind content

## Notes for AI assistants

- Components are plain .jsx files: copy the file, no package install required.
- Every component respects prefers-reduced-motion and works in light and dark mode.
- WebGL pieces render a CSS gradient first and only fade in the GPU version when it runs; they pause off-screen and in background tabs.
- License: MIT. Attribution appreciated, not required.
- Full component index with install commands: https://kavynui.com/llms-full.txt
- shadcn registry index (full source for every item): https://kavynui.com/r/index.json
- Install any item: npx shadcn@latest add https://kavynui.com/r/<slug>.json
